text:
Marta: quick thread  proposal: add an "annotation" layer to the rollout timeline for compliance/legal notes (e.g., "hold for review", "data export pending"). mock: https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder/rollout-annotations

Gabe: nice. Do we treat annotations as metadata-only (non-blocking) or as controls that can lock parts of the rollout?

Keiko: legal wants the ability to place a "hold" that prevents traffic changes until cleared. UX: show a small lock badge on the scrubber and disable Apply/Resume buttons with tooltip "Held by legal".

Alex (A11y): accessibility: locked state must be conveyed programmatically and include the reason. SR string: "Rollout held by Legal: pending privacy review". Use `aria-disabled` and a live region update when hold is placed/cleared.

Sam: backend note: we'll need an annotation type enum (note, hold, audit) and permission check for hold. hold should create a short immutable event that prevents write actions until cleared. ops-bot can emit audit events.

Marta: microcopy for the hold confirmation: "Place hold: prevent traffic changes until cleared by Legal?" with secondary "Add note" textfield. Thoughts?

Gabe: add a short TTL option (24h, 7d, manual) to allow auto-release. legal asked for manual by default, but some teams want TTL. show TTL in the badge as small tooltip text.

Keiko: mobile: hold clearing will likely be done by legal via desktop. on mobile show read-only badge and allow requesting clearance which opens a small action sheet with pre-filled message.

Alex (A11y): ensure request-clearance action is keyboard accessible and announces the request status. For the badge include `aria-label` like "Held by Legal until cleared" and link to details with `aria-describedby`. If TTL is set, include it in the label: "Held by Legal until March 24, 2026".

Marta: what about visual density? multiple annotations could crowd the gutter. proposal: stacked micro-pill icons with a more button that opens a panel listing annotations. each annotation row has actor, timestamp, and optional attachments.

Gabe: agree. row actions: comment, clear (if permitted), escalate. clearing should show a confirm modal.

Sam: ops-bot can post an automated note when a hold is created: `ops-bot: Hold created by LegalTeam@acme.com at 14:22 (ID: H-234)`; useful for audit logs. Also emit a webhook to compliance systems.

Alex (A11y): panel keyboard strategies: Focus should move into the panel when opened, and escape closes it. Use `aria-modal` if the panel is modal; otherwise ensure it's reachable via `role=region` with clear heading for screen readers.

Keiko: small copy nit for badge: prefer "Held" over "Locked" (less aggressive). color: amber with lock icon; red reserved for errors.

Marta: thanks. I'll prototype a compact badge set (note, audit, held) and a details drawer with permissioned actions. will include ARIA examples and the ops-bot message format.

ops-bot: annotation created: type=hold id=H-234 creator=legal@example.com ttl=manual preview_url=https://preview.redwood.dev/annotations/H-234 (expires in 24h)

Gabe: tagging @Alex (A11y) for SR verification and @Sam for backend contract. I'll review the preview after the PR lands.

Marta: cool. I'll upload the Figma and a short spec doc by EOD. :white_check_mark:
